ns2:course.label: Honduras Water Project II
ns2:course.description: Second of two courses that assists an international rural community in establishing a holistic water system. Complete final engineering designs, project funding documents and governance guidance by working closely with alumni mentors and professional advisors. Open to students in all majors. Same as LAST 441. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: ENG 440 or instructor approval.
